formerNames: North Okanagan/Columbia Shuswap Regional Health Board
organization.description: Regional health board under the Health Authorities Act, designated as the North Okanagan Regional Health Board on 28 November 1994. M444/1996 continued it in the December 1996 reconstitution. Those orders provided for 4 community health councils to amalgamate into it. Renamed by express amending orders, each dated by the day it was made. Amalgamated into the Interior Health Authority on 12 December 2001 under the Regional Health Boards Regulation, B.C. Reg. 293/2001, which names it in Schedule A (signed 11 December, deposited 12 December).

properties.name: Simon Fraser

organization.description: Regional health board under the Health Authorities Act, designated on 16 December 1996 by combining the Simon Fraser and Burnaby health boards. Those orders provided for 3 community health councils to amalgamate into it. Renamed by express amending orders, each dated by the day it was made. Amalgamated into the Fraser Health Authority on 12 December 2001 under the Regional Health Boards Regulation, B.C. Reg. 293/2001, which names it in Schedule A (signed 11 December, deposited 12 December).

properties.note: New Westminster is too small to resolve on the 1997/98 inset. The 2001 boundary schedule for this region names Burnaby and New Westminster, and the Statistics Canada map places New Westminster in Simon Fraser.

properties.note: The Southern Gulf Islands are shaded but unnumbered in the inset. The 2001 boundary schedule runs Capital's edge along Houstoun Passage and Stuart Channel, which places Salt Spring and the southern Gulf Islands inside it.
